_readme: Prompts for the category header images, generated in Gemini and saved to
House style, applied to every prompt: wide 16:9, photographic, warm natural
light, Indian (Bengaluru) setting and people where people appear, palette
led by rose #c2456b, antique gold #c08a3e and cream, shallow depth of field,
no text or lettering anywhere in the image, no watermark, no collage.
Deliberately atmospheric rather than a catalogue shot: these head a category,
they are not photographs of any listing we sell.
style: Wide 16:9 photographic image, warm natural light, Indian setting in Bengaluru, colour palette led by deep rose pink, antique gold and cream, shallow depth of field, soft focus background, editorial event-photography feel. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no collage, no borders.
